title: Test 1
notes: Maintain fast pace and keep core engaged.

title: Box Breath Focus
notes: 4s Inhale, 4s Hold, 4s Exhale, 4s Hold.

title: Test 2
notes: Keep full plank position with crisp form.

title: Bodyweight Squats
notes: Drive hips back and push through heels.

title: Test 3
notes: Neutral spine, squeeze glutes and core.

title: Jumping Jacks
notes: Light on feet with steady rhythm.

title: Test 4
notes: Drive knees toward chest aggressively.

title: Shadow Boxing
notes: Throw jab-cross combinations staying light on feet.

title: Burpees
notes: Chest to floor and explosive jump at the top.

title: Walking Lunges
notes: Alternate legs, keeping knee over ankle.

title: Deep Diaphragmatic Breathing
notes: Inhale into belly, slow complete release.

title: Wall Sit Hold
notes: Thighs parallel to floor, back flat to wall.

title: Side Plank Right
notes: Keep hips lifted in straight alignment.

title: Side Plank Left
notes: Keep hips lifted in straight alignment.

title: High-Speed Vocal Articulation
notes: Repeat tongue twisters clearly & loudly.

title: High-Knee March & Twist
notes: Touch opposite elbow to rising knee.

title: Superman Hold
notes: Squeeze lower back, lift chest and thighs.

title: Rapid Eye Focus Tracking
notes: Shift gaze between distant and near targets.

title: Bicycle Crunches
notes: Controlled tempo, focus on trunk rotation.

title: Triceps Dips
notes: Keep shoulders back, bend elbows to 90 degrees.

title: Standing Calf Raises
notes: Pause at the top peak contraction.

title: Stutter Step Agility Footwork
notes: Fast feet on the spot as quick as possible.

title: Mindful Body Scan Meditation
notes: Observe physical sensations from head to toes.

title: Arm Circles Warm-up
notes: 15s forward circles, 15s backward circles.

title: Russian Twists
notes: Keep feet elevated if possible, touch floor sides.

title: Glute Bridges
notes: Squeeze glutes at top for 2-second pause.

title: Public Speaking Power Pose
notes: Stand wide, chest open, shoulders relaxed and confident.

title: Skater Jumps
notes: Lateral bounds side to side with balance.

title: Bear Crawl Hold
notes: Knees hover 2 inches off the ground.

title: Neck & Shoulder Mobility Rolls
notes: Gentle smooth circles, release all tension.

title: Flutter Kicks
notes: Press lower back into floor, small tight kicks.

title: Isometric Biceps Grip Push
notes: Press palms together forcefully at chest.

title: V-Sit Hold
notes: Balance on sit bones with extended legs.

title: Speed Shadow Skips
notes: Simulate high speed jump rope.

title: Forward Fold Stretch
notes: Hinge at hips, relax head and neck completely.

title: High-Pitch Vocal Warmup Sirens
notes: Slide pitch from low to high on "Ooh" sound.

title: T-Rotation Push-ups
notes: Rotate hand upwards toward ceiling after push.

title: In-and-Out Squat Jumps
notes: Land softly, alternating wide and narrow feet.

title: Visualization & Goal Affirmation
notes: Vividly visualize successful execution of your goal.

title: Cooldown Slow Walk & Shakeout
notes: Walk around, shake arms and legs to flush lactic acid.
